sanskrit_verse:
गोपशौण्डिकशैलूषरजकव्याधयोषिताम् ।
ऋणं दद्यात् पतिस् तेषां यस्माद् वृत्तिस् तदाश्रयाः ॥
transliteration: gopaśauṇḍikaśailūṣarajakavyādhayoṣitām / ṛṇaṃ dadyāt patis teṣāṃ yasmād vṛttis tadāśrayāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: The husband shall assume the debt of women engaged in pastoral, hunting, mountaineering, washing, or hunting professions, because their livelihood depends upon them.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through sustenance and guardianship
Causation is determined by existential dependency
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with economic reliance
Restoration logic centers on the continuity of life-support systems
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of interdependence
executable_legal_axioms: IF a woman's profession determines her survival AND that profession incurs financial liability THEN the husband assumes the obligation as primary guardian
IF a man is designated as protector THEN all liabilities arising from dependent’s livelihood become his by dharmic duty
IF economic activity is essential for subsistence THEN debts incurred therein transfer to the household head automatically
IF no explicit consent was withheld AND social role implies acceptance THEN assumption of obligation is immediate and non-negotiable
supreme_court_application: In matters involving professional liability of dependents whose existence relies on familial support structures, the court must recognize automatic transference of obligations to the recognized male head of household based on dharma, not contract. This reflects ontological responsibility rather than transactional agreement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Debt assumption arises naturally from pramāṇa-based relational roles where sustenance is tied to action. There is no fault assigned; only anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential unfolding of duty. The husband does not bear burden but fulfills position. Responsibility is proportional to capacity, not culpability.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Husband integrates dependent's financial history into his own records voluntarily
Responsibility assumption protocol: Public acknowledgment of custodial role through community declaration
Capacity restoration: Financial education provided jointly to both parties under guidance of elders
Integrity reintegration: Family unit re-established within broader societal framework without stigma
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling affirms SPH as origin of lawful alignment. Dharma stands restored through consciousness-led obligation. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
